findings.description: 'com.example.controller' (presentation) depends directly on 'com.example.persistence' (persistence), bypassing expected application/domain intermediaries.

metadata.executive_engineering_consequence: Skipped intermediaries couple UI/API directly to persistence.
metadata.executive_leadership_question: Where do components bypass required architectural boundaries?
metadata.executive_modernization_relevance: Boundary skips block safe service and module extraction.
metadata.recommendation_expected_outcome: Presentation/API no longer depend directly on persistence.
metadata.recommendation_rationale: Boundary skips couple distant layers and enlarge blast radius.
metadata.recommendation_validation: Confirm presentation→persistence edges are removed from the graph.
metadata.remediation: Route access through the expected application/domain boundary instead of reaching persistence or infrastructure directly from presentation/API layers.

findings.title: Architectural layer boundary skipped

findings.description: A directed dependency cycle was observed among 2 primary architectural units (com.example.application → com.example.domain → com.example.application) after nested-package collapse. Cycles increase change coordination risk.

metadata.executive_engineering_consequence: Changes in one component may require coordinated changes across the cycle.
metadata.executive_leadership_question: Where do circular dependencies increase delivery risk?
metadata.executive_modernization_relevance: Cycles should be addressed before modular extraction or service decomposition.
metadata.recommendation_expected_outcome: Acyclic package dependencies within the affected scope.
metadata.recommendation_rationale: Directed cycles force coordinated multi-component changes.
metadata.recommendation_validation: Regenerate the package dependency graph and confirm the cycle identity is absent.
metadata.remediation: Break the cycle using dependency inversion, a stable abstraction, responsibility realignment, or a shared neutral module. Regenerate the package dependency graph to validate removal.
